caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with four curved legs, a high backrest, and an upholstered seat. The wood of the chair is rendered in dark brown tones, with highlights and shadows that give it a polished, glossy appearance. The backrest features an ornate, hourglass-shaped central support. The seat of the chair is covered with a green cushion. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color with little to no texture or detail, and there is a faint shadow beneath the chair, indicating the light source. The artist’s signature appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Side Chair
